name: logo-cloud
title: Logo Cloud
description: A social-proof block: one row of company logos drifts sideways behind soft edge fades, with a second static row of the same marks underneath.
use: A landing page wants to show partner or customer brands without spending much space.
avoid: Logos are forced to solid white by a brightness filter, so multicolour brand marks lose their identity.
a11y: Images carry alt names, but the endless marquee ignores reduced-motion and cannot be paused. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two stacked rows of small white brand logos on near-black. The upper row is a continuous moving strip that fades at both ends under the label Trusted by developers worldwide; the lower grid is static under BUILT WITH.
behaves: The top row scrolls steadily from right to left on a loop, repeating the same logos. The bottom grid never moves.
customise: logos (name and image path), title and className are props on each of the three variants; the scroll speed and fade mask are fixed.
weight: light: A duplicated row of images moved by one CSS keyframe; no script.
